theme: An open Friday, likely in Maine
greeting: A quiet, open day, Dan — just a haircut this afternoon and tomorrow's show on the horizon. The real wins today are the bookings that have waited long enough, plus a likely morning call with Morgan Stanley.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Your p1 task (overdue since Sep 14) to hold a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week. The Pathfinder heads south this month, so this is the only six-seater for the girls' Maine trip — and holiday inventory there sells out early.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: Decide and book the three-week December trip for all four girls by Oct 15 (p2, overdue Sep 30). Passports land early-to-mid November, so the clean default is a domestic shortlist you can book now without risk.

needsAttention.title: Drive the Pathfinder south
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5-18 off-week window to drive Portland to St Pete is open right now and closes Oct 18. Set the dates and book the one hotel night; it replaces a flight rather than adding a trip.

needsAttention.title: St Pete Beach signing
needsAttention.detail: A second reminder this morning from the signing service for 102 26th Ave, St Pete Beach - the document is still waiting on your signature.

schedule.title: Haircut
schedule.detail: The one fixed point in the day.

flagged.title: "Confirm work authorization" email
flagged.detail: A third-party recruiting app (sourcehire.app) asks you to confirm visa/sponsorship status for a confidential SVP, Global Public Policy role (REQ64085). Plausible, but verify the sender before sharing anything personal.

flagged.title: New VP Public Affairs roles
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced two on-target openings overnight - VP Global Public Affairs at Estee Lauder and VP Global Government Affairs at KLA.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley call likely today
flagged.detail: You offered Scott any AM slot to talk through the KPMG 401k rollover; the vesting decision is still live, and a $15k ACH processed this morning.

flagged.title: LinkedIn device verification
flagged.detail: LinkedIn asked you to verify a new device last night - confirm it was you.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, job-board digests, and receipts - WSJ, NYT Cooking, St Pete local, Experian and Chase alerts, an Amazon shipment.

resolved.title: British Airways Visa payment posted
resolved.detail: Chase confirmed this morning your BA card payment was applied to the account.

recipe.title: Kabocha squash, yukon gold potatoes & cipolline
recipe.why: Deep into autumn, kabocha and sweet cipolline onions are at their peak — a single roasting pan of caramelized squash and potatoes for a cool October evening.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Portland house order - bedframe + soap holder

acts.line: A clear morning with nothing on the calendar - the right stretch to clear the travel bookings that keep sliding.
A 3:30 haircut is the only fixed point; the rest of the afternoon is yours.
Open and quiet, with the Black Keys at the State Theatre lined up for tomorrow.
